evidence.evidence_text: In this study, we introduce a two-dimensional analysis framework—comprising token back-tracing and individual token decoding—to uncover how LLMs conduct factual knowledge recall.
In this study, we introduce a two-dimensional analysis framework—comprising token back-tracing and individual token decoding—to uncover how LLMs conduct factual knowledge recall.

Through explanatory analysis of three typical reasoning datasets, we identify a consistent three-phase pattern: Subject Augmentation and Broadcasting, Object Retrieval and Reranking, and Conclusion Fusion and Generation.
